Do these settings strain or damage my system?
Not at all. These are just in-game settings suggestions (graphics quality, resolution, effects). Nothing changes on your phone\'s system files or hardware — it\'s completely safe.
What\'s the difference between green and yellow settings?
Green means the best FPS and smoothest performance (lower graphics quality). Yellow means the best visual quality (better for stronger phones, may give lower FPS).
What\'s the YouTube link and how do I use it?
Some games have a guide video instead of text settings. Just tap "Watch on YouTube" to open the YouTube app or your browser and watch it.
How do I change the app\'s theme?
Go to Settings (gear icon on the home screen) → Theme → choose Light or Dark.
How do I change the app\'s font?
Go to Settings → Font → choose one of the options (Vazirmatn, Sahel, Montserrat, Inter, or System Default).
